rv.q: It's a zany ride, but 'The SpongeBob Musical' is an uplifting show about never giving up, finding your inner strength and working together as a community for the greater good.
There's a good show buried in 'SpongeBob.' But it's buried deeper than Davy Jones' locker.
Kokandy's SpongeBob is one of the most purely entertaining shows of the year.
Kokandy's presentation has the same energy, imaginative creativity and jaw-dropping talent to make this entertaining, family-friendly show a bonafide Summer hit.
I missed that, but I can’t imagine it was any more delightful than what Kokandy Productions has concocted in the basement at the Chopin.

We meet the characters at the start of a typical Bikini Bottom Day, but the waters soon heat up when the seemingly inevitable eruption of a nearby volcano, aptly named Mount Humongous, threatens the city’s very existence.
